data.description:
Get ready to step into the boots of archeologist Scott Hudson and his loyal dog, Jack, as they embark on a quest to uncover the Iost secrets of the world's first civilization.

In EPYKA, you'll explore a mysterious island filled with ancient wonders, magical puzzles, and challenges beyond anything Scott could have imagined. What begins as a search for Earth's first civilization soon turns into a race against time to find Talima and confront an ancient evil threatening humanity.

{1116317513500301}

# A Magical Adventure Awaits
With Jack by your side, you'll unravel the island's mysteries, solve puzzles that merge history with magic, and explore a breathtaking civilization that will help you discover who you really are.

{476570144999819}

# Why You'll Love EPYKA:
**A Story You Can't Put Down:** Uncover EPYKA's hidden past and face a dark force intent on destroying the world.

**Explore a Stunning, Mysterious Island:** Traverse vibrant landscapes, ancient ruins, and hidden caves crafted to immerse you in EPYKA's world.

**Magical Puzzles:** Tackle unique challenges that blend ancient history with magic, unlocking powers to aid you on your journey.

**Characters You'll Connect With:** Experience Scott's determination, Jack's loyal companionship, and Talima's wisdom, brought to life through vivid animation and voice acting.

**Family-Friendly Adventure:** EPYKA offers a captivating and unforgettable journey—perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and VR newcomers alike.
